[package]
name = "wacore"
version = "0.7.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.95"
authors = ["João Lucas <jlucaso@hotmail.com>"]
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/oxidezap/whatsapp-rust"
description = "Core WhatsApp protocol implementation without runtime dependencies"
autobenches = false

[package.metadata.cargo-machete]
ignored = ["getrandom"]

[features]
signal-operations = []
mobile = []
instance-clock = []
session-simulator = []
debug-snapshots = []
legacy-session-interop = ["wacore-libsignal/legacy-session-interop"]
test-util = []
tracing = ["dep:tracing"]
metrics = ["dep:metrics"]
tracing-pii = ["wacore-binary/tracing-pii"]
js = ["getrandom/wasm_js"]
voip-control = []
voip = ["voip-control", "dep:aes-gcm", "dep:zerocopy"]
voip-mlow = ["voip"]
dhat-heap = ["dep:dhat"]
bench-internals = []

[dependencies]
aes = "0.9.2"
async-trait = "0.1.91"
itoa = "1"
log = "0.4"
rand = "0.10"
serde-big-array = "0.5"
thiserror = "2.0.19"

[dependencies.aes-gcm]
optional = true
version = "0.11.0"
default-features = false
features = ["aes", "alloc"]

[dependencies.anyhow]
version = "1.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.async-channel]
version = "2.5.0"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.async-lock]
version = "3"
default-features = false

[dependencies.base64]
version = "0.23.1"
default-features = false
features = ["alloc"]

[dependencies.bon]
version = "3.9.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.buffa]
version = "0.9.2"
default-features = false
features = ["json"]

[dependencies.bytes]
version = "1.12"
default-features = false

[dependencies.cbc]
version = "0.2"
features = ["alloc"]

[dependencies.chrono]
features = ["now", "serde"]
version = "0.4"
default-features = false

[dependencies.compact_str]
version = "0.10"
default-features = false

[dependencies.ctr]
version = "0.10"
default-features = false

[dependencies.dhat]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.event-listener]
version = "5"
default-features = false

[dependencies.futures]
features = ["std", "alloc", "async-await"]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false

[dependencies.getrandom]
optional = true
version = "0.4"
default-features = false

[dependencies.hashbrown]
version = "0.17.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.hex]
version = "0.4"
default-features = false
features = ["alloc"]

[dependencies.hkdf]
version = "0.13.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.hmac]
version = "0.13.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.metrics]
optional = true
version = "0.24"

[dependencies.portable-atomic]
version = "1"
default-features = false
features = ["fallback"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[dependencies.serde_json]
features = ["std"]
version = "1.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.sha1]
version = "0.11.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.11.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.smallvec]
features = ["serde"]
version = "1.15"

[dependencies.smoothutf8]
version = "0.2.3"
default-features = false

[dependencies.subtle]
version = "2.6"
default-features = false

[dependencies.fluent-uri]
version = "0.4.1"
default-features = false
features = ["alloc"]

[dependencies.tracing]
optional = true
version = "0.1"
default-features = false
features = ["attributes"]

[dependencies.wacore-appstate]
path = "./wacore/appstate"
default-features = false
version = "0.7.0"

[dependencies.wacore-binary]
features = ["serde"]
path = "./wacore/binary"
default-features = false
version = "0.7.0"

[dependencies.zeroize]
version = "1.9"
default-features = false
features = ["alloc"]

[dependencies.wacore-derive]
path = "./wacore/derive"
version = "0.7.0"

[dependencies.wacore-libsignal]
path = "./wacore/libsignal"
version = "0.7.0"

[dependencies.wacore-noise]
path = "./wacore/noise"
version = "0.7.0"

[dependencies.waproto]
path = "./waproto"
version = "0.7.0"

[dependencies.zerocopy]
optional = true
version = "0.8.55"
default-features = false
features = ["derive"]

[build-dependencies.buffa-build]
version = "0.9.2"
default-features = false

[build-dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.11.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies]
ciborium = "0.2.2"
ruzstd = "0.9.0"

[dev-dependencies.aes-gcm]
version = "0.11.0"
default-features = false
features = ["aes", "alloc"]

[dev-dependencies.url]
version = "2.5.8"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.divan]
package = "codspeed-divan-compat"
version = "=5.0.2"

[dev-dependencies.flate2]
version = "1.1.9"
default-features = false
features = ["zlib-rs"]

[dev-dependencies.futures]
features = ["executor", "alloc", "async-await"]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
features = ["macros", "rt", "rt-multi-thread", "time"]
version = "1.53.1"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dev-dependencies.wacore]
path = "."
default-features = false
features = ["bench-internals"]

[[bench]]
name = "reporting_token_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "usync_response_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "send_receive_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "message_metadata_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "token_lookup_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "signal_address_probe_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "history_sync_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "sframe_varint_benchmark"
harness = false
required-features = ["voip"]

[[bench]]
name = "message_utils_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "sync_recovery_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "appstate_sync_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "sender_key_derivation_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "prekey_store_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "media_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "retained_memory_benchmark"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "voip_benchmark"
harness = false
required-features = ["voip-mlow"]

[[bench]]
name = "mobile_workflow_benchmark"
harness = false
required-features = ["mobile"]

[[example]]
name = "voip_profile"
required-features = ["voip-mlow"]

[lints.clippy]
disallowed_methods = "deny"
disallowed_types = "deny"
dbg_macro = "deny"
todo = "deny"
print_stdout = "warn"
print_stderr = "warn"

[lints.rust]
unused_qualifications = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(docsrs)"]

[[test]]
name = "signal_store"
required-features = ["signal-operations"]
